h: West Brom beyond the High Street
p: West Bromwich High Street is the town's long main shopping street, with the Metro tram running close by. This branch is one of the Admiral adult gaming centres, which means 18+ only.

Football is a big part of life here, and The Hawthorns, home of West Bromwich Albion, is a short trip out of the centre. For history, Oak House is a striking timber-framed house from the 1600s with period rooms and gardens, a couple of minutes from the town centre. Sandwell Valley Country Park offers open countryside, lakes, an RSPB reserve and a working farm on the edge of town. The tram makes Birmingham and Wolverhampton easy to reach for a bigger day out.
